direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets at least 36px, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum and no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow along feasible routes, state glow on active stations, layered depth and cinematic 240ms route trace on real state change then static; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; no loops beyond the single living flow trace; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with depth, glow and bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade shows living emerald flow, state glow and depth across departments

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and add living emerald material flow from Receiving through feasible cells to JOB-1001 and JOB-1002, with depth shadows and glow only on active stations.
Refit the right zone so Source evidence cards sit in their reserved zone at 16px body with 36px Source detail targets and no crowding against the scene edge.
Add the persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend inside the scene reserved zone using pattern, marker and text.
Separate provider identity readiness checks from the investigation evidence task in the side zone, each with its own heading, status and control, so the two are never conflated.
Animate one emerald route trace from the verified findings to the feasible cells when findings open, then hold static; honour reduced motion by showing the completed trace without movement.
Enlarge the 3 / 0 / 3 metric labels to clear 12px micro-labels and keep the verified-facts cards aligned to the scene callout zone.
When a path is selected, surface one-click Approve in place, then present the Authorize this decision wall as the next gate; do not leave Review recovery option as an ambiguous endpoint.
Highlight the selected path bidirectionally between the side-zone card and its scene stations and jobs with emerald glow and a 2px focus ring on keyboard selection.
Keep DOES NOT MATCH inside stage bounds while aligning Certificate and Receiving tracks to the same scale as the enlarging scene.
Add cinematic depth to the board: raise t1 with emerald glow and shadow, keep t2 and t3 dashed and dimmed silver until approved, preserving PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL wording.
Enlarge task titles to 16px minimum body and keep Due and Awaiting approval lines inside each card reserved zone without overlap at 1366x768.
Make the 1 2 3 proposal stepper keyboard reachable with arrow keys and a visible emerald focus ring, announcing the active task via aria-live polite.

Strengthen the shock moment with a single cinematic transition: living flow stops at CELL-MILL-2, silver cross-hatching and x marker sweep in, and OFFLINE text settles; reduced motion shows the final hatched state immediately.
Add plain OFFLINE wording beside WILL GO OFFLINE in the preview card so meaning does not rely on hatching alone.
Keep the invalidating-action status centred in the 56px action bar at 16px so it never wraps at 1366x768.
Remove the large diagonal silver lines crossing CELL-MILL-2 text; use silver cross-hatching contained inside the station body with the x marker in the corner and OFFLINE at 16px.
Fill the empty Verified findings reserved zone with its collapsed summary at 16px so the side zone reads complete, keeping it separate from provider identity readiness checks.
Show only two feasible routes in emerald with living flow through CELL-MILL-1 and no route through the offline cell.
Apply the same contained cross-hatching refit to CELL-MILL-2 and to the constrained Split card so OFFLINE and CONSTRAINED text stay legible over the pattern.
When a revised path is selected, open one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall, mirroring the earlier decision gate exactly.
Add emerald glow and bidirectional highlighting between the selected revised path card and CELL-MILL-1 plus both jobs in the scene.

Make the coexistence explicit in the scene header zone: show 3 BLOCKED PRIOR as silver hatched prior cards alongside the approved revised plan while the 3 PROPOSED replacement tasks remain untracked until approval.
Add OFFLINE with cross-hatching inside the CELL-MILL-2 station card instead of text-only replan required, matching the legend pattern, marker and text.
Raise the replacement task cards with depth and a soft emerald glow on t1 only, keeping t2 and t3 dimmed until their turn.
Add a cinematic verified-chain trace across the 01 02 03 nodes when Verify ledger succeeds, with emerald glow travelling once then holding; reduced motion shows all three nodes lit statically.
Enlarge the right-zone passphrase guidance to 16px body and give Verify ledger, the passphrase field and Export independent checkpoint 36px targets with visible focus rings.
Keep 18 events. One verified chain. as the single hero line and align the 70 / 35h / 48h metrics on one tabular baseline.

Intensify living material flow: one clear emerald cascade route with glow and depth from CNC mills to CNC lathes and onward to feasible departments, so the recovery path reads instantly above the faint static lines.
Replace the small x glyphs on offline machines with silver cross-hatched machine bodies, x cross markers and plain OFFLINE labels at legible size inside every department zone.
Enlarge department and machine labels toward 16px where space allows and keep the Running/Held-Blocked/Offline/Feasible Recovery legend persistent at the top of the scene zone.

Enlarge the cascade visual within its required position so department names, OFFLINE labels and the emerald recovery route stay legible without zooming, and add a one-line caption naming the 35 affected operations.
Raise body copy contrast and keep the Live demo link and Powered by partners table at 16px equivalent so judge scanning stays fast inside the fixed presentation order.
Add depth and glow stills language to the hero and cascade pairing: show the emerald flow frame beside the silver OFFLINE frame so the living cascade reads as a before-and-after pair.
